description: IN-TASK-STANDBY (docs/operations/aws.md 22.9): how many successor processes the ECS task of each role holds at once, one per code bundle the merge queue wants, the oldest first: the heirs a landing swaps onto, inside the task (tower_infra.supervisor), at no cost of their own. 0 is off: a landing reloads in place. TWO-HEIRS (the Torre, 16/11/2026): 2, so a merge that lands while the entry behind it is still building, and that entry after it, both go live by the pointer's swap (the queue builds five entries side by side, #73); with 1 the task held the newest want and the entry landing first reloaded in place (#115, 16/11: 17 s). The maximum is 2 (supervisor.MOST): the service task has 1024 MiB and 0.5 vCPU since 13/11 and used 349-353 MB with one heir and its reserve (16/11), a second heir is ~100-120 MB and ~8 database connections more, and the database (db.t4g.medium, max_connections about 410) had 13-15 open.
